questions: If S itself is already a palindrome, should the output be S (since it's the shortest palindrome with S as prefix) or must we append something to make a longer palindrome?
When constructing the palindrome, are we allowed to insert characters only at the end, or also in the middle/beginning, as long as S remains a prefix?
Is the output required to be exactly the shortest palindrome, or is any palindrome with S as prefix acceptable as long as it's among the shortest?
Should the palindrome be case-sensitive? The input is uppercase English letters, but what about the appended part?
If multiple shortest palindromes exist (e.g., different characters can be appended to achieve same length), are all acceptable?
Is the palindrome required to be a contiguous string, or could it be a sequence where S is a non-contiguous prefix?
Can the appended part include characters not in the uppercase English alphabet?
What is the maximum length of the output palindrome? Is it bounded or could it be extremely long?
